siteMetadata.title: Theia Platform – Open, Flexible, and Extensible Framework for Building Cloud & Desktop IDEs and Tools
siteMetadata.description: Discover the Theia Platform, an open-source framework for building custom and tailored cloud and desktop IDEs and tools using modern web technologies without forking. Fully extensible and vendor-neutral, Theia enables the development of tailored, white-labeled, and domain-specific tools, supporting Language Server Protocol (LSP), VS Code extensions, and AI integration.
